sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: license eligibility, documents and the three tests
Knowledge facts: part C holds 40 fact blocks (sec02-F01 onward) from physical pages 9 to 15; part C2 holds 19 confusable and continuation blocks (sec02-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer (physical page 3), the June 2026 edition (physical page 1), the written test format, the 80 percent passing score, the one-test-per-day rule, the retest fee and the vision minimums from physical page 13; the question count and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- MN-LICENSE-A-COUNT — written test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- MN-LICENSE-A-TIME — written test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- MN-LICENSE-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- MN-LICENSE-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: retest fees, the enhanced card fee, appointment websites, phone numbers and document rules (for example sec02-F27, sec02-F38, sec02-R10) can change and must be refreshed from drive.mn.gov.

corpus_stability.reason: The Minnesota Driver’s Manual prints a single edition line (June 2026) on its front cover and opens with a New laws and information chapter that collects recent changes in one place, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
